meta.project: NR Enterprise website + admin inventory system

stack.frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind + shadcn/ui, built in Lovable, static build uploaded to cPanel public_html
stack.backend: PHP 8.1+ REST API (PDO) built with Claude Code, under public_html/api + nre_backend/ outside web root
stack.database: MySQL/MariaDB on the same cPanel hosting (no third-party database)
stack.pdf: Browser print CSS (A4) with embedded Bangla-capable font

brand.name: NR Enterprise

logo.notes: Logo = green NR monogram inside a yellow circle, wordmark 'NR ENTERPRISE' in black with italic serif tagline. Use nr-logo-full.png on light backgrounds; use nr-logo-mark.png (transparent circle) on dark/coloured backgrounds, favicon and admin sidebar.

yellow.use: Logo circle yellow. Primary CTA background, highlights, active states, section accents.

yellow_deep.use: Hover for yellow buttons, small icons on white.

yellow_soft.use: Light yellow tint for badges, callouts, row highlight.

green.use: Logo NR green. Decorative, icons, charts, success accents. Not for small white-on-green text.

green_deep.use: Headings accent, links, text on light bg, secondary button, admin primary.

ink.use: Logo black. Body text, headings, text on yellow.

contrast_rules: Text on yellow (#F8C840) is always ink (#201818). Never white on yellow.
White text only on ink_green, green_deep or ink backgrounds.
Never place small body text in #6FA33F on white (low contrast). Use green_deep.

typography.heading: Poppins 700 (same family as the business profile)

shape_and_motion.motion: subtle fade-up on scroll (200-350ms), image hover zoom 1.04, no autoplay carousels except client logo marquee
signature_elements: Dotted 'NR' watermark pattern (from the profile) as a faint background on hero and footer
Yellow bar + dark text label blocks as used in the profile (heading with yellow underline bar)
Rounded product cards with a yellow caption strip at the bottom of the image, like the profile's product grid

admin_theme.sidebar: ink_green background, nr-logo-mark at top, active item yellow background with ink text
admin_theme.topbar: white with line border, global search, user menu
admin_theme.tables: white cards, sticky header, zebra rows #FBF8EE, status pills

company.positioning: An ultimate garments trims & accessories manufacturer & exporter
company.positioning_note: Updated profile cover says 'manufacturer & exporter' (the earlier profile said 'supplier'). Use 'Garments Trims & Accessories' on the site until NR confirms whether it manufactures in-house.
company.motto: We blend People, Process & Technology to meet customer demand
company.closing_line: Make your brand's product stand out with our high-quality production line.
company.vision: To be the global Trims & Accessories company that respected brands, retailers and manufacturers choose to partner with.
company.mission: To create innovative, intelligent and sustainable ways to connect brands with consumers.

contact.notes: Profile shows Facebook and YouTube icons and a QR code with no links, and prints the email as a 'website'. Leave social/website as null; hide the icons until NR supplies links.

verified_use_on_site: Company name, tagline, logo, address, phones, email
Vision, mission, 'We synchronize supply with demand', People-Process-Technology message
Product list and product descriptions (19 lines)
Client brand logos (20) once NR confirms permission
Sustainability message (4R icons from earlier profile; environmental policy wording)

categories.name: Labels
categories.description: Fabric identification sewn into garments: woven, printed care and screen printed labels.

categories.name: Tags, Stickers & Tracking
categories.description: Paper and adhesive identification: hangtags, thermal and barcode stickers, RFID and variable-data labels.

categories.name: Trims & Accessories
categories.description: Physical garment components: sewing thread, elastic, twill tape, drawcords, cord stoppers and buttons.

products.name: Woven Labels
products.short_description: Sewn-in brand label with a permanent, durable finish.
products.description: Woven labels are the original label. Sewn into your garment, they are your brand's permanent signature and offer high quality and durability. Specialised in woven-edge technology, produced on modern machines with recycled-quality raw material.

products.name: Printed Care Labels (PFL)
products.short_description: Care and content labels printed on a wide range of fibres.
products.description: Care and content labels are small yet crucial to ensuring your product reaches the shop floor and the end user enjoys it as long as possible. Printed on polyester satin, taffeta, acetate, tear-away, nylon, poly-cotton blends, cotton, organic cotton and twill tape.

products.name: Screen Printed Labels
products.short_description: Vibrant colour at a relatively lower cost.
products.description: A popular alternative to woven labels thanks to colour vibrancy. Produced on in-house substrates, including cotton substitutes that are durable and do not fray.

products.name: Offset Printed Tags
products.short_description: Price tickets, hangtags, waist tags and secondary tags.
products.description: A swing ticket is the book cover to your brand. Wide range of price tickets, hangtags, waist tags and secondary tags with finishing such as die cutting, embossing, foil stamping, varnishing, stringing, eyelet and folding. Printed on eco-friendly recycled paper with soy-based ink.

products.name: Digital Printed Tags
products.short_description: Photo-quality tags with many designs in one run.
products.description: A cost-effective method for custom tags and labels with photographic-quality graphics, crisp text and vibrant colours. Multiple designs can be produced in the same run without delay, from startups to large-scale enterprises.

products.name: Thermal Stickers
products.short_description: Thermal printed price, carton, poly and box stickers.
products.description: Thermal printed labels and tags for barcode-oriented products: price stickers, price tickets, carton stickers, poly stickers, box stickers and more.
features: Price, carton, poly and box stickers

products.name: Barcode Labels & Stickers
products.description: Barcode and QR code labels and stickers for identification, tracking and retail scanning.

products.name: RFID Labels & Tags
products.short_description: RFID labels and tags for inventory and supply-chain tracking.
products.description: Radio frequency identification used in manufacturing, inventory control, warehousing, distribution, logistics, automatic object tracking and supply-chain management. Labels and tags produced in-house.

products.name: Variable Data Labels
products.short_description: Tickets and labels carrying changing data through the supply chain.
products.description: Variable data tickets and labels communicate critical information throughout the supply chain as a product makes its way from production through to store.

products.name: Flexo Printed Adhesive Labels
products.short_description: Roll adhesive labels printed by flexo.
products.description: Flexo printed adhesive labels and stickers on rolls for packaging and product identification.

products.name: Adhesive Labels & Tags
products.short_description: Adhesive labels and tags in rolls and sheets.
products.description: A range of adhesive labels and tags for packaging, cartons and product identification.

products.name: Sewing Thread
products.short_description: Cotton, polyester and silk thread for strong, smooth seams.
products.description: A vital component in garment production, designed to hold fabrics together with strength and flexibility. Available in cotton, polyester and silk for durability, smooth seams and a refined finish.

products.name: Elastic
products.short_description: Stretchable elastic for waistbands, cuffs and more.
products.description: A stretchable material for flexibility, comfort and a secure fit. Commonly made from rubber or spandex blended with fabric fibres. Available in various widths and strengths for waistbands, cuffs and other areas needing stretch and recovery.

products.name: Twill Tape
products.short_description: Strong flat woven tape with a diagonal pattern.
products.description: A flat woven tape with a distinctive diagonal pattern, known for strength and durability. Made from cotton, polyester or a blend, widely used for binding edges, reinforcing seams and creating ties in garments and home textiles.

products.name: Drawstring / Drawcord
products.short_description: Coloured cords with tipped ends for hoods and waists.
products.description: Coloured drawstrings and drawcords with tipped ends for hoodies, joggers, shorts and bags.

products.name: Cord Stoppers
products.short_description: Plastic and metal toggle stoppers for drawcords.
products.description: Plastic and metal cord stoppers (toggles) for drawcords, hoods, waists and bags.

products.name: Metal Snap Buttons
products.short_description: Brass-finish snap buttons with custom logo.
products.description: Metal snap buttons in antique and other finishes, with custom embossed logos. Four-part sets: cap, socket, stud and post.

products.name: Plastic Buttons
products.short_description: 2-hole and 4-hole plastic buttons in many colours.
products.description: Durable plastic buttons in two-hole and four-hole styles across a wide colour range.

products.name: Shell / Pearl Buttons
products.short_description: Pearl and shell buttons for shirts and premium wear.
products.description: Pearl and shell-finish buttons for shirts and premium garments.
